name: orchestration-strategy
description: Evaluate multi-task workloads and select the most cost-efficient orchestration approach: solo, parallel, sequential, or Agent Teams.

interface.shortDescription: Choose between solo, parallel, sequential, or team execution.
interface.longDescription: Evaluates a multi-task workload and recommends the most cost-efficient way to run it: a single agent, parallel subagents, sequential subagents, or a coordinated agent team, with worktree isolation where tasks would collide.
defaultPrompt: How should I orchestrate these five tasks?
